summary: Elevra Lithium filed a Form 6-K furnishing an ASX announcement dated 2 November 2026 concerning a venue name change for its 2026 Annual General Meeting. The AGM remains on Thursday, 19 November 2026 at 10:30am Brisbane time (11:30am Sydney), in person at 80 Albert Street, Brisbane (Capri by Fraser, renamed Novotel Brisbane City Centre from 1 November 2026) and virtually. The Notice of AGM, resolutions, explanatory material, proxy deadline and online platform are unchanged; lodged proxies remain valid. This is a routine meeting logistics notice, not a special situation.
